content:
emma: New signup (emma+trial@acme.com) didn't get trial credits. Verified email and phone, added card, UI shows welcome but balance 0. Account acct_01GXXXX — can we check? :confused:

support-bot: Thanks! Manual review ticket SUP-3421 created for acct_01GXXXX. If you need faster help, mention @raj.

raj: @emma can you paste the exact email and steps the user took? Any aliasing (+ addressing) or company domain?

emma: email used: emma+trial@acme.com. Steps: 1) sign up via email, 2) add card, 3) verify email. UI says "Welcome to Redwood" but credits = 0. Card shows added (last4 4242). Region set to UK.

raj: ok. can you run the credits endpoint and paste the body?

emma: response from GET /v1/accounts/acct_01GXXXX/credits -> `{ "balance": 0, "pending_grants": ["promo_trial_v1"], "gates": ["email_alias", "payment_review"] }`

raj: looks like two gates. "email_alias" kicks in for plus-addressing/aliases that match patterns we treat as higher risk. "payment_review" is triggered by BIN mismatch / 3DS pending. That combination keeps auto-grants blocked. I'll escalate to billing ops to consider manual grant. @oliver tagging you.

oliver: on it. quick checklist: 1) confirm BIN (last4 4242) and country, 2) check if account.email contains plus address (it does), 3) check recent device/IP signals. Manual grant possible if signals are okay. ETA ~30m.

emma: user phone +44 7700 900123, they also attempted signing in with base email emma@acme.com and still saw 0 credits. They uploaded no documents.

oliver: confirmed BIN shows issuer country US, user region UK -> triggers payment_review. Given low fraud signals and matching phone, I'm authorizing manual grant for promo_trial_v1. Applying now.

oliver: PATCH /v1/accounts/acct_01GXXXX/credits -> 200 { "balance": 50, "pending_grants": [] }

oliver: SUP-3421 resolved. @emma please ask user to hard refresh and confirm credits appear. If still 0, send a screenshot of the billing API response and network tab.

emma: user refreshed, balance updated to 50. Closing this thread, thanks all :tada:
